name: Get newsletter
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the details of a specific newsletter (campaign) by its identifier, such as its name, content placeholder, and type. Use the list_newsletters action instead if you need to discover multiple newsletters at once.

id.description: The unique identifier of the newsletter to retrieve.

editorType.description: Optional editor mode flag used by the UI; observed value 6.

name.description: The display name of the newsletter.

content.description: The newsletter's content payload; may be null if not yet defined.
